description: Shiba studies printed charts on a sunlit floor.

title: Riders of the First Dawn
description: Vitalik and Shiba ride side by side as ancient warriors, turning a familiar Ethereum friendship into an imagined classical legend.
alt: Vitalik and the Shiba wear ancient bronze armor and ride a pale horse and a dark bay horse side by side in a classical landscape.

title: The Shiba of Giza
description: A monumental Shiba-headed Sphinx rests before the pyramids, as though this watchful face had belonged to the desert for centuries.
alt: A monumental limestone Sphinx with a carved Shiba head rests before three pyramids in a bright desert landscape.

title: Shiba of the Golden Garden
description: Shiba rests beside irises and flowing water in a Japanese-inspired painting, where gold leaf and quiet brushwork give his familiar face a timeless calm.
alt: A black-and-tan Shiba rests among indigo irises, pine branches and a silver-blue stream against a traditional Japanese-inspired gold-leaf ground.

title: The Guardian Fresco
description: Painted into an imagined ancient Roman wall, Shiba carries an olive branch through columns and vines—a familiar guardian preserved in pigment and plaster.
alt: An ancient Roman-style fresco shows Shiba carrying an olive branch between painted columns, vines and geometric borders.

title: Bronze Ascendant
description: A powerful canine Shiba twists into an ascending bronze pose beside the Charging Bull, with sculpted animal barding and bright metallic highlights.
alt: A muscular bronze canine Shiba rises in an asymmetric turning pose, wearing sculpted animal barding beside the separate Wall Street Charging Bull.

title: Beyond the Frame
description: An ancient Shiba warrior drives an Ethereum-shaped spear downward from a rearing horse, with the horse, spear, and gripping paw projecting beyond a gilded frame.
alt: An armored Shiba on a rearing horse thrusts an Ethereum-shaped spear downward; the gripping paw, spear and horse's raised legs project beyond a gold frame.

title: The Shiba Geographer
description: In a Vermeer-inspired study, Shiba pauses over a map with dividers in his paw, contemplating a world larger than the room around him.
alt: A traditionally painted Shiba scholar in an indigo robe pauses with dividers above a map in a window-lit study with a globe.

title: The Opening Move
description: Shiba joins a Renaissance garden chess match, turning an Anguissola-inspired scene into a quiet contest of wit, patience, and a very confident paw.
alt: A Renaissance-style painting shows Shiba moving a chess knight while two women watch in a garden terrace setting.
